judged_text: `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` and `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...))` throw on malformed or undecryptable input with no try/catch, so the endpoint returns a generic 500 instead of a 4xx. A parent app sending a bad payload (wrong encryption key, non-JSON keys) gets an opaque 500 with no diagnostic, and each attempt logs a stack trace server-side instead of rejecting with the 400 the request contract implies.

adjudication.rationale: In the newly added API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` is called without a try/catch, so invalid/malformed bodies will throw a ZodError and result in an unhandled exception (Next.js will return a 500). Similarly, `symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, ...)` and the subsequent `JSON.parse(...)` are not guarded; if the ciphertext is undecryptable (e.g., wrong key/invalid input) or the decrypted plaintext is not valid JSON, these will throw and also produce a 500. The diff shows no error handling that would convert these into a 4xx response.
